items.title: SD-082 validation retest: proposer_post_action per-candidate summary restores candidate-discriminating propagation (ON>OFF contrast, 5 seeds)
items.note: SD-082 VALIDATION RETEST. Designated validation_experiment for the SD-082 substrate_queue entry, whose per-candidate-summary AMEND landed 2026-08-30T11:32:08Z (ree-v3 merge ef88faa) and which recorded V3-EXQ-822d as 'PLANNED but NOT YET QUEUED ... a /queue-experiment follow-on session is needed'. Routed by the confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822c_2026-08-29 Section 6. Both arms run candidate_summary_source='proposer_post_action'; the pre-registered acceptance is SD-082's own -- C1 on_prop_delta_mean >= 1e-3 AND C2 (on-off) > 1e-3 on a majority of seeds (plain conjunction, recorded as interpretation.combination_rule). | SEEDS 3 -> 5 on the autopsy's own Section 4 finding that Scale is 'INSUFFICIENT for the ON-vs-OFF read (3 seeds, direction inverts)' -- C2 is exactly that read. 101/202/303 kept verbatim from 822a/822c; 404/505 new. | GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is on_prop_delta_mean + the per-seed ON-OFF contrast measured under proposer_post_action, a config value that did not exist before ree-v3 3aa45de (2026-08-30). 0 of the manifests in REE_assembly/evidence/experiments/ mention 'proposer_post_action' or 'candidate_summary_degenerate'; 822/822a/822b recorded n_prop_samples=0 in all 18 cells (no data at all) and 822c measured the DEFECTIVE path. Not recoverable -> run. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): FIRES and is RELEASED. Under the skill's predicate (substrate_ceiling category OR non_contributory direction, keyed by run at most-recent adjudication) SD-078 = 4 hits and SD-082 = 2 hits, both >= threshold 2 -- braking autopsies failure_autopsy_816c-822_2026-07-26, failure_autopsy_batch-822a-826-817a-827_2026-07-26, failure_autopsy_2026-07-28-sweep, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-822c_2026-08-29. RELEASED because the named upstream substrate is now BUILT: the most recent counted autopsy's recommended_substrate_queue_entry is {action: amend, target_sd_id: SD-082}, IMPLEMENTED at ree-v3 ef88faa (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md 'SD-082 AMEND: per-candidate summary was a shared constant'). This is the first test of the claim on substrate that can carry the signal, not a fourth blind lettered iteration. (The 822c autopsy recorded 'brake does not fire' using the narrower R1-R3 predicate that counts only literal substrate_ceiling readings; both readings are stated so a later reader need not reconcile them.) | DV-SYMMETRY (per arm). Manipulation = crf_cue_centering. prop_delta_mean is a symmetric aggregate over candidates and is invariant under adding a candidate-independent constant to the per-candidate rule-ablation difference; the manipulation is NOT invariant under either -- but only BECAUSE of the fix. rule_state is broadcast identically across candidates, so under the pre-fix 'proposer' path (constant summaries) the ablation difference was one shared constant and the manipulation WAS invariant in the relevant sense, which is why 822c's prop_delta was an arithmetic artifact rather than a measurement. Readiness gate (e) certifies that invariance is broken (cross-candidate post-centering spread ratio) BEFORE C1/C2 are read. rule_flip_frac is invariant under a broadcast constant on the bias vector, so it was structurally pinned at zero pre-fix -- 822c measured exactly 0.0000 in all 6 cells, an independent arithmetic confirmation; it is recorded as a DIAGNOSTIC and is NOT gating and NOT load-bearing, because flip>0 is confirmatory but flip==0 is not decisive. rule_state_diff: manipulation acts directly on what it measures, no invariance. candidate_summary_norm_pre/post_centering: EXPECTED arm-independent by design (centering of the rule cue does not touch candidate summaries) -- a readiness measure of the fix, not an effect measure. | Step 2.5c: resolved by call-trace over 30 real ticks of this driver path, not module-name matching. No OPEN corrupting entry overlaps except SD-082 itself (which this run validates, and whose corrupting failure_record is marked resolved by the fix): salience_coordinator.py, blocked_agency.py, ContextMemory.write / compute_write_addressing_loss / agent.compute_prediction_loss and probe_warmup.py are all NOT on the executed path (this driver is pure forward/select and never trains E1). KNOWN LIMITATIONS, both severity 'degrading' and both open, noted per the gate rather than blocking: SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING (implemented_pending_validation; ree_core/agent.py, causal_grid_world.py) and mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism (implemented_pending_validation; causal_grid_world.py) -- neither mechanism is enabled in this config, but the run happens under both open defects. | Ethics preflight (Step 2.6): all involvement flags false, decision allow. | Does NOT supersede 822c: 822c is the diagnostic that measured the defect and its failure_record is 'resolved' (not 'superseded') by the fix this run validates. | Smoke PASS (--dry-run, Mac): fix engaged in the real driver loop -- 0 dispatch fallbacks, 0 degeneracy-guard ticks, worst spread ratio 8.67e-3 vs the 1e-3 floor (legacy ws[0,0,:] measures ~2.2e-9), magnitude ratio back inside [1e-3,1e3] from 822c's 2.8e6-4.5e6, and rule_flip_frac NONZERO (ON 0.214 / OFF 0.067) where 822c had exactly 0.0000 in all 6 cells. The toy run correctly self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue with non_degenerate=false on the compressed-P2 prop-sample gate, confirming that gate is reachable and functioning.

items.title: SD-e1-item1 action-conditioning validation: ON-vs-OFF per-action divergence, C3/cr_ratio non-gating (queue-refill chip chip-20260829-sd-e1-item1-validation-exq-b)
items.note: Validates SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training ITEM 1 (ree-v3 26557a3758, 2026-08-29; design doc REE_assembly/docs/architecture/sd_e1_rollout_consistency_training.md, commit REE_assembly 1f8870d290): E1's forward transition is now action-conditioned via a dedicated LSTM input channel (E1Config.action_conditioned_transition / action_cond_unzero_self_slot), replacing the single-projection path V3-EXQ-954 (2026-08-29, PASS, confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-954_2026-08-29) showed floors per-action divergence at h=1 with the horizon-compounding signature absent (cr_ratio 4.76e-07/5.39e-07 vs a 0.1 bar; red-team attribution: ~5,000x per-action attenuation inside E1, prior_generator ~7x, LSTM+output_proj ~675x dominant, still untouched by this build). SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT INSTRUCTION (per the originating chip): this is NOT a retest of C3_VAR_THRESHOLD / cr_ratio -- those are ITEM 2's target (the multi-step/rollout-consistency training objective, still pending_implementation). ITEM 1 is an interface-only fix; cr_ratio(h)/e1coe_score_var are recorded per the existing V3-EXQ-954 methodology (unchanged Phases 1-4/4b) as ITEM 2's future baseline but are explicitly non-gating -- see interpretation.non_gating_reference in the manifest. ITEM 1's own load-bearing criterion (Phase 4c, redesigned from 954): a direct-channel one-step per-action divergence probe holding (z_self_0, z_world_0) bitwise fixed across all K actions and varying only the actions= one-hot passed to agent.e1(...) -- the isolated test of ITEM 1's own dedicated channel, independent of any E2-mediated indirect route (954's Phase 4c routed actions through E2 first, which predates ITEM 1 and cannot isolate it). DESIGN: 3 arms (A_off action_conditioned_transition=False / B_action True+unzero=False / C_both True+unzero=True) x seeds [42,123] (matches 954's seeds so A_off is checkable against 954's own recorded numbers via readiness precondition P_OFF_ARM_REPRODUCES_954). Acceptance: per-cell (arm in {B_action,C_both}, seed) relative_lift = ratio_action_vs_real_h1[ON]/ratio_action_vs_real_h1[OFF] >= LIFT_FACTOR, where LIFT_FACTOR = max(3.0, 2.0*measured_off_arm_cross_seed_noise_ratio) is DERIVED from this run's own OFF-arm measurement (never an inherited historical constant, per the V3-EXQ-936a both-tails-need-floors lesson), PLUS an absolute floor (ON arm's raw action_cr >= 1e-7) AND an absolute-lift-multiple guard (ON action_cr >= 2x the matched OFF action_cr) so a 'lift' cannot be manufactured from an OFF arm sitting at numerical noise. Label PASSes (action_conditioning_converts_both_arms / _one_arm) when >=1 arm clears all three on every seed. Five P0 readiness preconditions (encoder_trained, real_zworld_nondegenerate_h1, no_missing_action_calls [vacuity trap 1: E1DeepPredictor._action_cond_missing_calls==0 -- every actions= call this script makes on an action-conditioned E1 supplies a real, freshly-constructed one-hot, verified non-None+exactly-one-hot at each call site, so this trap cannot fire by construction], direct_action_supply_fraction>=0.999 [this script's own buffer-free analogue of vacuity trap 2/3, since it -- like 954 before it -- never calls REEAgent._e1_tick() and so never populates the internal _action_experience_buffer; agent.e1_action_buffer_stats() is recorded for cross-reference ONLY and is EXPECTED to read nonzero_fraction=0.0, documented explicitly in the module docstring so this is not mistaken for a defect], off_arm_reproduces_954 [A_off's ratio_action_vs_real_h1 at h=1 < 1e-3 on every seed]) all self-route substrate_not_ready_requeue on failure, never a false PASS/FAIL verdict. agent.record_executed_action() is called after every REAL env-executed action (Phase 0b training, Phase 1 goal template, Phase 2 warmup state, Phase 4b real-state sampling) in every arm per the chip's explicit instruction and for _last_action hygiene across other REEAgent subsystems -- but is deliberately NOT the source of any actions= tensor this script passes to agent.e1() (those are always freshly-constructed local one-hots), and is deliberately NOT called in Phase 4/4c (imagined/synthetic candidate evaluation, not real execution -- calling it there would conflate imagination with reality per MECH-094-adjacent hygiene). Uses experiments/_lib/zworld_p0_warmup.run_zworld_p0 (SD-070 sanctioned encoder warmup, RNG-neutral) + arm_fingerprint.arm_cell() per (arm,seed) cell (config_slice_declared=True) + write_flat_manifest/stamp_recording_core (standard recording core) + experiment_protocol.emit_outcome (runner-conformance sentinel). EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE=diagnostic, claim_ids=[] (this validates the ITEM 1 substrate build itself, deliberately separate from the governance-routed MECH-135/INV-088 pending_retest_after_substrate claims retest that ITEM 1 unblocks -- per the chip's explicit framing, tagging those claims here would be speculative per REE_Working/CLAUDE.md's claim_ids accuracy rule). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): the decisive readout (per-action one-hot-conditioned E1 one-step divergence on a TRAINED, action-conditioned E1, isolated via a direct actions= channel) does not exist in any prior manifest -- 954's own manifest predates ITEM 1's build by construction (it is the failure record ITEM 1 was built to address) and its one-step probe routes actions through E2, never through E1's own actions= channel -> not recoverable, proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): not applicable -- validates a substrate that did not exist until ree-v3 26557a3758 (2026-08-29); no prior autopsy exists to brake against at this granularity. SMOKE (--dry-run, 2026-08-30, seed 42 only, reduced scale n_train=2/zworld_p0=3/steps_ep=50/n_sequences=5/horizon=10/n_real=15): all 3 arms PASS their internal readiness; A_off K=5 pairwise_dist mean/min/max EXACTLY 0.0 (bitwise action-blindness reproduced by construction, as documented -- z_self_0/z_world_0 identical across all K actions when the action channel is inert), ratio_vs_CR_real(h=1)=2.07e-07 (well below the 1e-3 off-arm-reproduces-954 ceiling); B_action/C_both both show genuine nonzero per-action divergence (pairwise_dist mean ~3.5-4.1e-04, ratio ~4.0-4.6e-03), clearing the derived LIFT_FACTOR=3.0 (measured OFF-arm cross-seed noise ratio 1.0 at this reduced single-seed smoke scale, so LIFT_FACTOR floors at its 3.0 absolute minimum) by roughly 4 orders of magnitude on the ratio statistic; label=action_conditioning_converts_both_arms, status=PASS, non_degenerate=True, vacuity checks clean (missing_action_calls=0, direct_action_supply_fraction=1.0 on all arms). Queue was starved (floor 3, actual 2 before this add) -- this is an explicitly wanted refill per the originating chip.
